title: splitbill: five shared-expense issues (even split, percent split, settle-up, currency conversion, refunds)

issues.title: even split: extra cents to the first people, negative totals mirrored
percent split: must add up to 100, largest-remainder shares
settle-up: largest debtor pays largest creditor, name ties, zero-sum check
currency conversion direction, half-up rounding, codes, unknown currency
refunds: negative amounts in the importer and in the balances
